scope: Reusable base-color/PBR preset for the T-shirt shell; no artwork or garment geometry included.
applicationNotes: Apply the linear baseColorFactor, roughnessFactor, and metallicFactor using the glTF 2.0 metallic-roughness workflow.
The matte roughness and zero metallic value keep specular response restrained; fold readability still depends on garment normals, geometry, and neutral scene lighting.
Keep any chest-flower artwork as a separate UV-aligned artwork layer or texture; this preset does not contain it.

source.provenance: Cream color follows the ATEL-35 owner brief. PBR values are an artist-authored reusable visualization preset; no external texture or measured material data was used.
source.limitations: Cotton-like is a visual simulation only; these values do not describe or certify real textile composition, hand, or production properties.
